Craig, saw XFactor.io launch MIKEY and bring on a new Chief Strategy Officer right after the $16M Series A.

Scaling a new revenue platform that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before targets ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XFactor off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Post-raise, the number tends to climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit it. The gap shows up late, and then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XFactor needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how XFactor's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
